user.title: Smart pause for a Versatile Thermostat
user.description: Pause the equipment of an over_climate thermostat while the room does not need it and will hold without it.

data.power_entity: Power or energy of the equipment

data_description.threshold_heat: Below this setpoint, VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint up, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.threshold_cool: Above this setpoint, VTherm's own auto start/stop switches the equipment off and on. From this setpoint down, the smart pause decides. Empty: the smart pause always decides.
data_description.weather_entity: Hourly forecast of the outdoor temperature and the clouds, used to predict how long the room holds.
data_description.power_entity: Optional. Lets the plugin pause only an equipment that consumes, and estimate the energy avoided. A delayed energy counter works too.
data_description.compressor_entity: Optional. On while the compressor runs.
data_description.defrost_entity: Optional. On during a defrost (or a preheating): no decision, no learning.

error.not_a_vtherm: Pick a climate entity of Versatile Thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a smart pause.

data.power_entity: Power or energy of the equipment

data_description.setback_heat: Setpoint sent while paused. Empty: the thermostat's minimum temperature.
data_description.setback_cool: Setpoint sent while paused. Empty: the thermostat's maximum temperature.
data_description.comfort_margin: The pause ends before the room passes the setpoint by this much on the uncomfortable side.
